description:
The status bar in the Elixir implementation is missing cost/token information that appears in the Node.js version.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
~/Workspace/octo_pi (main)
R7.1k ↓781 ↑1.6k 1.5%/197k (auto)  (openrouter) minimax/minimax

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
~/Workspace/octo_pi (main)
↑5.4k ↓599 R8.9k $0.003 1.8%/197k (auto)  minimax/minimax-m2.7

Differences:
1. Elixir shows 'R7.1k' (Received?), Node.js shows '↑5.4k' (clearly an up arrow)
2. Elixir shows '↓781', Node.js shows '↓599' - both have down arrow
3. Elixir shows no cost (/bin/zsh.00), Node.js shows '$0.003'
4. Elixir shows '(openrouter)' prefix, Node.js does not
5. Elixir shows model as 'minimax/minimax-m2.7' without quality indicator, Node.js shows 'minimax/minimax-m2.7 • medium' with quality indicator

The cost display and token counts should be implemented.
title: TUI-2: Missing cost/token display in status bar
